_readme: COMPLETE known-good instabox config patch — this is (minus repo specifics) the exact config tic-tac-toe ran its full 17-issue backlog on (2026-10-24/25, every lap machine-lane). Unlike config.skeleton.instabox.json (a minimal delta), this carries EVERY allowlisted field so an operator never has to copy another project's config to be sure nothing is missing (magpie onboarding, 2026-10-25). The config verb deep-merges this over the onboard defaults; repo/slug/default_branch/scenario.ports were set at onboard and are not patchable. Prerequisite: the factory-base-r2 snapshot must exist VPS-side (foreman bake <slug>) BEFORE the first lap. Decision points you may want to change: merge.required_checks (this example ships [] because tic-tac-toe had no CI; use ["*"] to autodetect every check the PR reports, or explicit names), per-stage thinking levels, and stage_minutes.
